from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.assets.vector_search import get_intent_parser

class Hou_Mcp_Intent_Parser(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_intent_parser"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("intent_text", "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("environment",  "string")
        self.add_output("role",         "string")
        self.add_output("category",     "string")
        self.add_output("storytelling", "string")
        self.add_output("lookdev",      "string")
        self.add_output("cinematic",    "string")
        self.add_output("confidence",   "float")
        self.add_output("parsed",       "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        intent_text = str(inputs.get("intent_text") or "").strip()
        try:
            parsed = get_intent_parser().parse(intent_text)
            d = parsed.to_dict()
            return {
                "environment":  d.get("environment", ""),
                "role":         d.get("role", ""),
                "category":     d.get("category", ""),
                "storytelling": d.get("storytelling", ""),
                "lookdev":      d.get("lookdev", ""),
                "cinematic":    d.get("cinematic", ""),
                "confidence":   d.get("confidence", 0.0),
                "parsed":       d,
                "exec_out":     True,
            }
        except Exception as e:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_intent_parser failed: {e}")
            return {"environment": "", "role": "", "category": "", "storytelling": "", "lookdev": "", "cinematic": "", "confidence": 0.0, "parsed": {}, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Intent_Parser
